description: Curated catalog of native PC and Android ports of classic games — decompilations, recompilations and reimplementations. Official sources only, never download links.

Native Android port of the Sonic R PC decompilation (jnmartin84). Features a custom GLES2 shader pipeline, 60 FPS, customizable touch controls, and SAF asset installation. Requires original PC game files (no retail assets included). Non-commercial open-source project.
